title: Split WebChat HTTP tests by route, message-part, history, and server behavior
description: The WebChat HTTP implementation is split, but its 500+ line test module still mixes submit routes, message-part normalization, reply/media validation, history readback, and live server behavior. Split tests before WebChat auth, SSE/WebSocket, and attachment storage expand the same file.

files.change: Keep shared imports/helpers and declare focused test submodules.
Move text/image/message-part submit route coverage here.
Group reply-only, non-image media, and empty payload behavior.
Move recorded history serialization and filtering coverage here.
Keep bound TCP server and reqwest smoke coverage separate from route-unit tests.

criteria: Shared helper setup is in one support module, not copied across tests.
Future auth/streaming/storage tests have clear destination modules.
